situation: You are going away for three weeks. Your friend lives nearby, and you would like your friend to look after your home while you are away.
task: Write an email to your friend in about 150-200 words. You are asking your friend to take care of your home.
points: Explain where you are going and for how long.
Describe what you would like your friend to do.
Offer something to thank your friend for the help.
sample:
Hi Daniel,

I hope you and your family are doing well. I am writing because I need to ask you for a big favour.

My sister is getting married in Portugal next month, so I will be away from July 4 to July 25. It is the first time in five years that our whole family will be together, and I am really excited about it.

While I am away, would you be able to look after my apartment? My cat, Milo, needs fresh food and water every morning, and his litter box should be cleaned every two or three days. I would also be grateful if you could water the plants on the balcony twice a week and pick up my mail from the lobby. I will leave a spare key and written instructions with you before I go.

To thank you, I would love to take you and Anna out for dinner at your favourite restaurant when I get back. I will also bring you something nice from Portugal.

Please let me know if this works for you.

Thanks so much,

Kevin
